lines.text: How to hide from the Nazis in a wine barrel. A quick guide.
Step one. Empty the barrel. Drinking it is allowed. Encouraged, even.
Step two. Climb in. Become the wine.
Step three. Do not answer. Especially not with, non.
Step four. Wait. Nobody ever checks the Merlot.
The soldiers leave. You survive. And you smell like a fancy dinner party.
